units.source_text: 此后发生的事情实是令人难以置信。

en.t: What happened after that was truly unbelievable.

units.source_text: 女子依然保持着端庄的姿势，冷不防地解开了衣领口。

en.t: The woman, still maintaining her dignified posture, suddenly loosened the opening of her collar.

units.source_text: 我的耳朵几乎听见了从坚硬的腰带里侧拉出绢带的春市声。

en.t: My ears could almost hear the rustling sound of a silk cord being drawn from inside the stiff sash.

units.source_text: 莹白的胸脯袒露出来了。

en.t: Her gleaming white chest was exposed.
I drew in a sharp breath.

units.source_text: 女子公然用自己的手将一只莹白而丰满的乳房托了起来。

en.t: The woman openly lifted one gleaming white, full breast with her own hand.
